subject.title: feat(codex): instrument dynamic-tool bridge phase timing

question: Should Codex dynamic-tool bridge timings be emitted as an unconditional info-level production log on every completed call, or should this observability be scoped behind the existing diagnostics/logging policy?
rationale: The code can safely carry non-enumerable metadata, but the acceptable production logging volume and operational retention policy are product and ownership choices rather than a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Approve always-on timing logs
options.body: Keep the current per-call info record after an owner confirms its production volume and retention are acceptable.

options.title: Scope the logging policy before merge
options.body: Define the intended diagnostic level, sampling, or opt-in boundary and update the implementation and proof to match it.

recommendation.title: Scope the logging policy before merge
recommendation.body: Define the intended diagnostic level, sampling, or opt-in boundary and update the implementation and proof to match it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the Codex app-server runtime and its operational behavior.
